newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - S&P assigns A rating to PTTEP notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - S&P assigns A rating to PTTEP notes.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said it has assigned its long-term A rating to Thailand's PTTEP International Ltd's proposed US$200 million 144A notes due 2006.
The notes would be guaranteed unconditionally by the parent company, PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited (PTTEP).
The rating reflected PTTEP's key public role, its close operational ties to the government of Thailand, and a good competitive position in the oil and gas industry.
The proceeds from the offering will used to fund PTTEP International's exploration, development and production activities, as well as for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
PTTEP International was established by PTTEP to invest in oil and gas projects in Thailand and neighbouring countries.
